Upon entering, the spacious and bright layout of the ground floor immediately stands out, with the different living areas connecting naturally and comfortably. At the heart of the living space is the generous kitchen, featuring a central island and equipped with all the necessary built-in appliances. The island provides plenty of space for cooking and dining together, while the open-plan layout creates a natural connection with the dining area. In addition to the main living area, the property features a separate seating area that is ideally suited as a comfortable TV room. This creates several inviting spaces for relaxing, entertaining and spending time together, while maintaining the open character of the home. The large windows and two sliding doors provide an abundance of natural light and create a direct connection with the garden. On warmer days, the sliding doors can be opened completely, allowing the interior and exterior spaces to flow almost seamlessly into one another. Combined with the high-quality finish and views over the greenery, this floor provides a particularly comfortable and inviting living environment. First floor The first floor features the master bedroom with its own ensuite bathroom, including a bathtub and a double walk-in rain shower. In addition, there are two further bedrooms, a second separate bathroom and a separate toilet. The combination of multiple bedrooms and two bathrooms on this floor provides a high level of comfort and privacy. Attic floor The attic floor offers a surprising amount of space and flexibility. It features a bedroom with its own bathroom, a separate laundry room and a home office. The home office can easily be converted into a fifth bedroom if desired, allowing this floor to be adapted to various living requirements. The space is also ideally suited for working from home, accommodating guests or creating a more independent sleeping area. OUTDOOR SPACE One of the key features of Lindewetering 30 is undoubtedly the size of the plot. With an area of 638 m², the property offers considerably more outdoor space than many comparable homes in the immediate area. The beautifully landscaped garden provides plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors throughout the day and forms a natural extension of the living areas. The open position directly adjacent to the park provides additional peace, privacy and a strong sense of space. Thanks to the exceptional size of the plot, the property also offers interesting possibilities for the future. The nearby major roads provide easy access to Amsterdam-Zuid, while the train station offers convenient connections to both Amsterdam and Utrecht.
